lang: ca
ref: figura-constanti-permutacions
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/constanti-pedagogia.json]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/constanti-permutacions.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/constanti-pedagogia.json').read_text())
edges=np.array(d['permutation']['edges']);counts=np.array(d['permutation']['histogram'])
assert counts.sum()==9999
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'constanti-permutacions'})
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.7,4.5),layout='constrained')
ax.bar(edges[:-1],counts,width=np.diff(edges),align='edge',color='#88b6ca',edgecolor='white',lw=.5)
ax.axvline(d['moran']['I'],color='#b32d42',lw=3)
ax.annotate('Observat: 0,192',xy=(d['moran']['I'],0),xytext=(.97,.64),textcoords='axes fraction',ha='right',
    color='#b32d42',fontsize=18,arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#b32d42'},bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none'})
ax.text(.97,.93,'Només 3 de 9.999 barreges\narriben a aquest valor o el superen',transform=ax.transAxes,ha='right',va='top',fontsize=17,
    bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.95})
ax.set(xlabel='I de Moran calculada en cada barreja de les 98 potències',ylabel='Nombre de barreges',
       title='Quin resultat dona canviar les potències de lloc?')
ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.12);ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/constanti-permutacions.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
